decisions.title: Modular monolith on single local host
decisions.summary: Single TypeScript process with account-scoped local SQL transactions; no Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, or new trading framework.

decisions.title: Fresh runtime composition root with one-way compatibility facade
decisions.summary: Do not import legacy server/app.ts, server/desk.ts, sample market fallbacks, or providers/mock into the replacement runtime.

decisions.title: Bybit V5 linear as reference market; native venue readback for execution
decisions.summary: Reference market analysis uses Bybit linear (1m/5m/15m/1h/4h/1d); execution venues still read their own rules, quotes, positions, fills, and stops.

decisions.title: Single embedded local SQLite ledger
decisions.summary: Settings, events, intents, positions, authority epochs, inbox/outbox, nonces, conversations, and lessons share local SQL transactions under .mpu-gandring/rebirth/runtime.sqlite.

decisions.title: Six logical roles frozen per task; Jev remains non-voting advisor
decisions.summary: Exactly one accepted completion per cycle/role/phase. Jev has zero voting or order authority and never becomes a seventh role.

decisions.title: Bot transport authentication separated from human Owner authorization
decisions.summary: HMAC callback authenticates paired peer transport for results/status only; actorRole=owner is untrusted without independent human proof or one-time local Owner grant.

decisions.title: Account lifecycle registry with ACTIVE and DRAINING contexts
decisions.summary: Switching venue/account directs new intents to ACTIVE while retaining DRAINING monitoring, protection, and close capability until exposure is terminal.

decisions.title: Local prepare-then-activate settings coordinator; separate remote ack
decisions.summary: Candidate resources prepare before serialized local activation barrier; savedVersion, activeVersion, and lastAcknowledgedConfigVersion stay distinct.

decisions.title: Local Kill flattens; remote Grok STOP halts entries and retains open positions with SL/TP
decisions.summary: Approved explicitly by Boss on 2026-10-31: local Kill keeps cancel + flatten behavior; Grok STOP latches durable halt ON, turns Auto OFF, cancels unfilled entry/nonprotective orders, and retains open positions with resting SL/TP (zero strategy CLOSE intents; separate emergency protection guard remains active).

decisions.title: Preserve Node >=20 engine floor
decisions.summary: Verify native dependencies and build artifacts without silently raising the Node >=20 requirement.

decisions.title: Preserve N bounds 1..4 during migration pending explicit Owner schema decision
decisions.summary: Keep OPEN_ORDERS_N / maxPositions at 1..4 and preserve exact saved Owner values without overwriting account capital fields when applying presets.

decisions.title: Isolated and labelled PAPER and backtest sandboxes
decisions.summary: No sample market or mock provider in the real decision graph; PAPER and backtest run in explicit simulation modules without signing credentials.

externalUnknowns.detail: Installed .env values, active trading mode, open exchange positions, venue balances, and resting stops on Boss machine were intentionally not read.

externalUnknowns.area: Grok Bot live pairing and routine installation
externalUnknowns.detail: Live Grok webhook routine acceptance, six-bot group delivery receipts, and remote workspace synced files require a separate authorized operational probe.

externalUnknowns.area: Inbound HTTPS callback reachability and TLS
externalUnknowns.detail: Separate callback ingress requires Boss-selected TLS/tunnel routing before BIDIRECTIONAL_VERIFIED can be claimed.
Grok Bot shared-computer HMAC proves peer transport, not human identity; direct HT-DM Owner mutation remains gated behind local one-time Owner grant until product attestation is proved.

externalUnknowns.area: Overlapping standalone Grok exchange credential revocation (AC-15)
externalUnknowns.detail: Single-executor handover requires external proof that overlapping exchange API keys or standalone order routines on Grok are disabled/revoked and pending fills reconciled.
Deterministic protocol fixtures verify adapter code contracts only; native read-only and testnet order/stop lifecycle require separate authorization.
